entries.title: Psalms 116:1
segments: ¶I have given my love to the Lord, because he has given ear to the voice of my cry and my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 116:2
segments: He has let my request come before him, and I will make my prayer to him all my days.

entries.title: Psalms 116:3
segments: The nets of death were round me, and the pains of the underworld had me in their grip; I was full of trouble and sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 116:4
segments: Then I made my prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, take my soul out of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 116:5
segments: The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly, he is a God of mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 116:6
segments: The Lord keeps the simple; I was made low, and he was my saviour.

entries.title: Psalms 116:7
segments: Come back to your rest, O my soul; for the Lord has given you your reward.

entries.title: Psalms 116:8
segments: You have taken my soul from the power of death, keeping my eyes from weeping, and my feet from falling.

entries.title: Psalms 116:9
segments: I will go before the Lord in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 116:10
segments: ¶I still had faith, though I said, I am in great trouble;

entries.title: Psalms 116:11
segments: Though I said in my fear, All men are false.

entries.title: Psalms 116:12
segments: What may I give to the Lord for all the good things which he has done for me?

entries.title: Psalms 116:13
segments: I will take the cup of salvation, and give praise to the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 116:14
segments: I will make the offering of my oath to the Lord, even before all his people.

entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: Dear in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his saints.

entries.title: Psalms 116:16
segments: O Lord, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of her who is your servant; by you have my cords been broken.

entries.title: Psalms 116:17
segments: I will give an offering of praise to you, and make my prayer in the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 116:18
segments: I will make the offerings of my oath, even before all his people;

entries.title: Psalms 116:19
segments: In the Lord's house, even in Jerusalem. Praise be to the Lord.
